script_text: This week, cosmic forces collide and Aries faces a transformative seven days. Early Monday through Wednesday, the Sun transits your 2nd House in Taurus, supercharging your finances—perfect for salary negotiations or a side hustle. But watch Wednesday closely: Mercury squares Saturn, creating communication roadblocks that could stall a career deal. Thursday marks your turning point as Venus in Gemini sextiles Mars in your 4th House, awakening romantic energy and heartfelt home conversations. Love intensifies over the weekend as Jupiter in Cancer continues blessing your domestic sphere—plan a date night Friday or Saturday. Wednesday is your worst day because Mercury square Saturn delays contracts and muddles important messages. Friday is your power day because Venus sextiles your ruling planet Mars, magnetizing attraction and emotional breakthroughs. As a fire sign ruled by bold Mars, move with confidence but read the fine print before Thursday. Follow for daily updates.
